svg.aria-label: Flowchart of the Deterministic Bounding Procedure: initialize, then loop — solve the follower exactly at the proposed tax, update the incumbent, add a value-function cut, re-solve the relaxation — with four decisions determining five exits, of which two are certified optima.
svg.title: Deterministic Bounding Procedure — control flow
svg.desc: The DBP loop alternates between a relaxation master, which proposes a carbon tax and yields a lower bound on emissions, and an exact follower solve at that tax, which yields an upper bound and a value-function cut. Closing the emissions gap is not sufficient to stop: the procedure additionally requires the master to stop proposing a smaller tax, which is what certifies the least-intervention tax.

svg.text: One pass of the bilevel loop, with every exit the procedure can take. Iteration index k; τ is the carbon tax.
